comments.author: Donce
comments.body: Can be plundered from Bounty fleet Ambush attack in Northern British Isles. I got mine today at around 15857:1655. Enemy ships like to run away, so you have to be fast. After attack, you need to wait about 5 minutes for next attack, and you have to be moving (good to grind Rowing skill :P)
